title: Qwen2.5-3B BNB fixed-row K2/R3 budget sensitivity
status: finite B1 development result; B1 exactness passed, B2 token identity did not hold at 256 tokens

protocol.linear_schedule: BNB NF4 Linear4bit padded to physical_rows=3

decision: K2/R3 padded BNB is a strong long-generation B1 candidate: it exceeded 1.15x B1 speedup in every prompt-level aggregate at 64 and 256 tokens. The 256-token BNB-relative point estimate was 1.024x, but both intervals include 1 and all BNB token sequences diverged. Keep the workload horizon explicit; do not claim B2 equivalence or general BNB speedup.
limitations: Three previously used CNN/DailyMail development prompts on one RTX 4050 and one pinned software/model revision.
Repeated sessions reuse the same prompts; prompt-level intervals use only three prompt units.
The BNB-relative 256-token estimate is inconclusive and the token trajectory differs from original BNB.
Finite state hashes do not prove all-input equivalence.
